QuestInfo.name: Spiritual Power 2
QuestInfo.0: You can see [Fox Trot] and [Spirit Bond] in your skill window. Ask Moonbeam how to use these skills.
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam tells you that you can use [Fox Trot] to travel quickly AND to close in on your enemies. Try it out after setting it to a hotkey!
QuestInfo.2: Moonbeam taught you how to use [Fox Trot]. You can use the skill to quickly move about.\n\n

default.0: Try out your [Fox Trot]! You should hotkey the skill for convenience.
